### P1 fix: Test 5 deterministic (no OR)

**Before:** `(is422 && hasErrorRows) || is500` (non-deterministic)
**After:** `is422 && hasErrorRows` (422 ONLY — deterministic)

### P1 fix: Error classification

| Scenario | Classification | HTTP | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| Duplicate requestId (data validation) | 422 | 422 | ✅ |
| Missing requestId (field validation) | 422 | 422 | ✅ |
| DB/infrastructure failure (Prisma) | 500 | 500 | (outer catch) |

Route logic:
- Importer catch → 500 (DB/infrastructure errors)
- Validation errors → `errors[]` → `errorRows > 0` → 422
- Outer catch → 500 (unexpected)

### P1 fix: Cleanup fail-closed + exact fixture IDs

**After:** `RETURNING id` — verifies cleanup, reports counts
